evidence: Has the Mining label and modifies `src/node/miner.cpp`, `src/node/tx_collection.cpp`, `src/node/block_template_manager.cpp`, and `src/interfaces/mining.h`.
rationale: Adds `TxCollection` to bandwidth-efficiently validate external block templates against the node's local mempool. This provides a critical interface capability for Stratum v2 Job Declarator Servers (JDS), eliminating redundant mempool mirroring and round-trip transaction transmission overhead.
